comment: Verification contract for T-007 (high, tdd per the risk-gate-matrix high-tier row). stack: shell waives lint/typecheck/build. unit-tests / acceptance-tests carry TDD red_evidence (the panel-round-6 RED captures, 341/4 in both runtimes against the pre-fix resolver -- the red that matches the shipped, post-remediation code) and green_evidence (355/0 in both runtimes); the sh capture is the unit check, the pwsh capture the acceptance check, together proving both runtimes. The green tally rose from 345 to 355 in panel round 7, which closed the Anthropic panelist's Major: AC-059/TEST-059 (ruling E, 2026-08-28) had been written into requirements.md, acceptance-tests.md, traceability.md and this task's Done When, but never implemented -- a repository grep for AC-059, TEST-059 and the three approval-surface path literals returned zero hits outside the spec documents. TEST-059 now exists in this task's own suite as the registration-time deny-list grep AC-059 specifies (scanned set: the Resolver alone, all three of resolve-project-context.{py,sh,ps1}), contributing ten assertions. Its non-vacuity is proved by mutation rather than by a suite-level RED, because a test-only addition has no failing production state to capture: verification/T-007/mutation-proofs-test059.log injects one mention of each of the three surfaces into the staged Resolver, records TEST-059 failing with all three categories named, and restores the file to its exact shipped sha256. Round 8 then closed the OpenAI panelist's Critical: _rollback_transaction rolled resolver-evidence.yaml back along with the publication artifacts on the post-publication-mismatch path (Evidence commits last, and the rollback set was entries[:count]), against REQ-001 step (m)'s explicit

. Evidence is now excluded from the rollback set and from the count the diagnostic reports; the same mutation log carries that second mutant, which the post-publication case kills on two assertions. Green stays 355/0 in both runtimes, and the nine sibling regression suites were re-run at these bytes (631 passing, 0 failing). regression covers the nine sibling suites at the shipped state: resolver-evidence-schema 20/0, match 125/0, cli 13/0, discovery 24/0, lite 18/0, validate-resolver-evidence 138/0, parity 70/0, metamorphic 150/0, component-path-resolver 73/0 (631 passing, 0 failing). requirement-traceability runs check-traceability against the feature's traceability.json (8 links, exit 0). check-component-coverage is not carried as a contract check: this repository has no sdd/project-context.yaml, so the gate is in disabled-legacy state and check-contract's CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS predicate does not activate the tier-minimum requirement (its verdict record was still captured for the record at verification/qg/T-007/component-coverage.log, state 'not-applicable (disabled-legacy)', exit 0); this matches sibling tasks T-008/T-009/T-010. cross_model is 'required' rather than omitted because this task's tasks.md entry carries Security-Sensitive: true, which sdd-ship Step 4 makes a hard pre-gate requirement; the cross-model-verification check is DEFAULT-FAIL here and stays passes:false until a fresh panel round has run against the shipped bytes and check-cross-model has written the aggregate at verification/T-007.cross-model.json. spec_revision is the current requirements+design+acceptance-tests concatenation hash.
